plasmoRUtils

plasmoRUtils provides an R interface to Plasmodium and other apicomplexan databases, together with utilities for parasite bioinformatics workflows. For further details, we recommend you read our preprint.

Note: Programmatic access to VEuPathDB requires an API key. Set VEUPATHDB_API_KEY in your user .Renviron file before using the authenticated database functions.

Installation

The recommended installation method is:

install.packages("pak") # install pak if necessary
pak::pkg_install("Rohit-Satyam/plasmoRUtils", dependencies = TRUE)

Alternatively, install dependencies and then use the GitHub installer:

  1. Install relevant dependencies:
# nstall CRAN dependencies using CRAN, and Bioconductor dependencies using Bioconductor.
install.packages(c("BiocManager", "remotes"))
BiocManager::install(c("topGO", "biomaRt", "rtracklayer", "GenomicFeatures",
                       "txdbmaker", "AnnotationForge", "SingleR", "SingleCellExperiment",
                       "scuttle", "Biostrings", "pRoloc"), ask = FALSE) 
# The GitHub installer also resolves the package's declared dependencies.
  1. You can install the development version of plasmoRUtils using:
remotes::install_github("Rohit-Satyam/plasmoRUtils", dependencies = TRUE)

Check installation

After installation, load the package as follows:

# Once installed load the library as
library(plasmoRUtils)

## Check and install missing optional dependencies # MODIFIED: this helper can install packages
install_dependencies()

Contributing

We’re excited to have you contribute to this package! If you’d like to help out, try to follow the same style and conventions used in the current functions - where it makes sense, of course. If you have any ideas or suggestions, don’t hesitate to reach out—opening a GitHub issue is usually the best way to start the conversation.

Just a heads up: this project has a Contributor Code of Conduct, so by getting involved, you’re agreeing to play by those rules. Thanks for helping make this project better!
